_description: Pin-table column headings that the PDF text layer loses, read off the rendered page instead. Keyed by datasheet file name and table label; the list replaces the headings the parser recovered, position by position. A '-' marks a column the table grid contains but the printed table does not, which pdfplumber picks up from a stray rule. Besides `columns`, an entry may carry `function_column`: the role of the table's single alternate-function column when the printed heading names the wrong one (the parser reads the role off the heading).
_verification: Each entry was checked by rendering the page with pypdfium2 and reading the heading visually, then confirming the data columns line up with the parsed grid.
